name: apple-music-dj
description: Your AI Apple Music curator — taste profiling, playlists from your real listening, discovery and insights. Try the built-in demo with no tokens.
author: Andernet (Matthew Anderson)

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEV_TOKEN
envVars.description: MusicKit developer token (JWT). Needed for anything that reads your Apple Music; not for the demo. scripts/setup_auth.py creates it.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
envVars.description: Music User Token from signing in with Apple. Needed for your own listening data and playlists; not for the demo. scripts/setup_auth.py gets it.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT
envVars.description: Two-letter storefront code (e.g. us) to override region auto-detection.

envVars.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
envVars.description: MusicKit key ID, read only by setup_auth.py / generate_dev_token.py to sign a developer token.

envVars.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
envVars.description: Apple Developer Team ID, read only by setup_auth.py / generate_dev_token.py.

envVars.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
envVars.description: Path to your MusicKit .p8 signing key, read only by setup_auth.py / generate_dev_token.py. Never sent anywhere.

envVars.name: APPLE_TOKEN_EXPIRY
envVars.description: Developer-token lifetime in seconds for generate_dev_token.py (default and maximum 180 days).

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_API_BASE
envVars.description: Testing/demo hook pointing the API wrapper at a local mock. Loopback addresses only; anything else is refused.

envVars.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DJ_DEMO
envVars.description: Set by demo.py for the scripts it runs, to mark demo mode. Not meant to be set by hand.
